candidates.title: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks
candidates.reason: StreamingLLM is a focused inference framework for bounded KV retention in effectively unbounded streaming contexts, with direct memory and decoding-speed effects.

candidates.title: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
candidates.reason: Foundational distributed MoE training system combining automatic sharding with conditional computation at very large scale.

candidates.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache
candidates.reason: Focused KV-cache quantization method with hardware-conscious implementation and direct peak-memory, batch-size, and throughput improvements.

candidates.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
candidates.reason: Foundational grouped-query attention method targeting decoder inference speed and KV bandwidth while preserving quality.

candidates.title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
candidates.reason: Foundational multi-query attention paper explicitly reducing KV tensor memory-bandwidth cost in incremental Transformer decoding.
